presentation_summary: Three-year history of polyarthralgia, fever, sweating, severe dry cough, and weight loss.
New bilateral lower-limb pain after 10 minutes of walking, relieved by rest.
Exam showed pallor, weak peripheral pulses, and right subclavian bruit.
Inflammatory markers repeatedly elevated, with CRP 35-146 mg/L and ESR 60-90 mm/h.
Chest CT showed inflammatory lymph nodes around the descending thoracic aorta and mild descending aortic dilation to 3 cm.

risk_context.source_text_value: Brucella IgM and IgG were elevated on several occasions and he received five courses of treatment
